![Starting the MDS Chapter (art by @amelicart on ig)](../../images/first-week.jpg){width=250, fig-align="left"}

I officially started off my Master of Data Science program this month, and honestly, it feels so nice to be back on the UBC campus! I won't lie, getting used to the rigorous new schedule and the daily commute has been a bit of an adjustment, but the silver lining is that the drive has given me the perfect excuse to finally get lost in a new sci-fi audiobook. Beyond the early mornings and the traffic, orientation week was a blast, and I’ve already met so many amazing new friends in my cohort. It’s definitely a busy season of transition, but I am so excited for everything this program has in store!
